title: Modified Car Maintenance
subtitle: Bolt-ons, tunes, and sticky tires — keep the build reliable with honest shop lines for ECU and boost work.

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Forced induction usually shortens oil and spark intervals — follow the calibrator's schedule, not just the door sticker.
Modified Subarus: watch head-gasket symptoms, oil consumption, and intercooler pipe clamps after pulls.
High-mile modified cars need cooling and clutch/trans health checked before adding more power.
EV performance mods (suspension/brakes/wheels) still need torque-spec shop work — don't DIY HV systems.
